string.text: On: the emission boss can come when an emission meets a hunt (see Emission boss chance). Off: he never comes, hunts during emissions are normal hunts, and one waiting to come is called off. The debug box still forces him. Default on.

Chance, rolled once per emission, that the emission boss comes when an emission meets a hunt: a hunt running when the emission starts is called off, or a hunt about to start during one is taken over. He haunts the exits of the building you shelter in, arrives with a lightning strike and walks in after you. He comes in the deadly part of the emission, when its waves hit, and never outside one. 0 turns him off. Default 100.

Chance, rolled once per emission, that the emission boss comes even when no hunt meets the emission, so between hunts too. Not in the grace period, and not while you are in a base, in a dialogue, asleep or underground. 0 turns it off. Default 6.
Name of the emission boss, a Sin (UNISG when you are Monolith, Zombified or Sin). Default: Ilarion Hrech
How much less damage the emission boss takes from every hit, on top of his armour and the escalation. NPC damage reduction below comes on top for hits from other stalkers and mutants. Default 30.
How much less damage the emission boss takes from other stalkers and mutants, so they are little help against him. Your own hits are not affected. Him only. Default 70.

The part of the horde that comes from the other side of your shelter, past the ghosts at the door farthest from his, to take you from behind. Only zombified stalkers, and only when your shelter has two doors or more. 0 sends everyone with him. Default 30.

Mutants that come 20 seconds before the emission boss, from beyond the ghosts on his side, and rush in after you: zombified stalkers, with a snork on mid maps and two tougher snorks on late maps. They fight any enemy they see on the way. 0 sends none. Default 4.
The share of your whole psy bar you lose each time the emission boss's ghosts push you back (at their ring or a door). Psy protection does not lower it. 0 turns it off. Default 4.
